item.title: Vlog: Christmas Lights Parade in Palm Springs, CA
item.description: Santa, Rudolph, and the other reindeerThe annual Christmas Lights Parade came again to Palm Springs, CA on December 7, 2024, and it was my first time attending. The community gathered together downtown to see the colorful floats, marching bands, dancers, and more. It attracted people from miles around. In the video blog below, I share a recap of the parade for you to enjoy. Happy holidays!

item.title: Vlog: Baking Vegan Vasilopita (Greek New Year's Cake) Recipe
item.description: New Year's Eve is here! If you're looking for a nice dessert to offer your guests, this Greek recipe may also be the one for you. It's a Vegan Vasilopita, a traditional Greek New Year's Cake made with a coin inside for one guest to find, giving them good luck throughout the new year. The full recipe can be found at The Daily Dish. My video, baking this cake and trying it afterward is below.I wish you a prosperous, loving, healthy, and adventurous New Year.

They require two 'AA' batteries and have two options for lighting, constant and flashing light. item.title: Vlog: Vegan Minestrone Soup with Beyond Meat Spicy Sausage
item.description: This cold and chilly season is still here, so I decided to prepare a vegan minestrone soup with Beyond Meat spicy breakfast sausages from my freezer. This hearty soup is the perfect meal for a cozy evening at home. The video recipe shares all the ingredients you need, and remember to use your favorite herbs and spices. item.title: Cruise Vlog: Stateroom Breakfast and Shore Excursion to Pompeii in Naples, Italy
item.description: Naples, Italy, is where I traveled to visit the once bustling city of Pompeii. The culture and their daily happenings were insightful and eye-opening. item.title: Vegan Girl Scout Cookies Unboxing and Review
item.description: Vegan Girl Scout Cookie OptionsIt's Girl Scout Cookie season, and I found vegan options to unbox and share in the video below. There were some great options if you enjoy a nice cookie with a cup of afternoon tea. The Toast-Yay cookie will be retiring at the end of 2025, so if you enjoy this one, stock up before they are gone.Share in the CommentsWhich Girl Scout Cookie is your favorite?

item.title: Video Blog: Visiting Chania, Crete in Greece on Cruise
item.description: Chania Old Town, along the waterfrontCruising is a fantastic way to see various cities in international waters. This time, I had the opportunity to visit Chania, a city in Crete. We were supposed to visit Santorini; however, the cable cars were being repaired while we were passing through, so we were redirected to Chania. This city is charming, and the waterfront along Chania Old Town is breathtaking, even in the rain. In the video below, I share a brief recap of my time in Chania. Happy travels

item.title: Video Blog: Visiting Kusadasi, Turkey - The House of Virgin Mary, Basilica of St John, and Ephesus
item.description: During my Mediterranean cruise, I visited the beach town of Kusadasi in Turkey. There are many places to visit and things to see. The area is beautiful and very modern. I also visited popular destinations, including The House of the Virgin Mary, The Basilica of St John the Apostle, and Ephesus, an ancient city with excavations reporting from classical Greece to the Roman Empire.
